name: print-social-black-indigo-blob-speaker-announcement-card
title: Speaker Announcement on Indigo Blob
whatItIs: A dark event poster with 'Meet the Speaker' in light and italic type, a rounded portrait card over a big indigo splat shape with a mic icon, the speaker's name and role, an info bar with date, socials and ticket link, and sponsor logos.
whatItMeans: The indigo blob gives the portrait a lively backdrop, and the tidy info bar keeps the details clear.
techniques: Organic blob shape behind a rounded portrait
Three-cell info bar for date, socials and tickets
Faint grid and square outlines in the background
Sponsor logos in a row at the base
bestFor: Dark posters with a splash of colour

vocabulary.definition: A portrait and details announcing one speaker.
A strip with practical details divided into cells.
A bold organic shape used as a backdrop.
